records.subject: Welcome aboard, Bright Collective
records.body:
Hi Sam,

Thanks for joining Wrenfield. If this is your first project-management tool for the team, the biggest adjustment is usually just getting into the habit of logging tasks here instead of a doc or a chat thread.

Happy to help with that transition.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

draft.subject: Quick hand with your next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

Glad the Slack integration issue you reported is sorted on our side — thanks for flagging it, and the ticket is now closed.

Since then you've got your first project set up and an invite out to a teammate, which is the right order of things: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. If it's useful, teammates can also be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through the next step with you and your team so the habit sticks.

Best,
Priya
